note: The bands the AeroTetris C-130 Hercules 3077 plant has to land in, from docs/HERCULES-STAGE1.md, which derives each from AeroTetris's published figures, the full size C-130H scaled to the kit, E-flite's for the Power 25 and APC's for the 12 x 8E (scripts/hercules-derive.js prints the derived figures). Each band is the Kadet's in proportion about its derived figure, as the Kadet's are the Bombshell's. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

h1_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 9.67 at 6.728 kg on the kit's 104.86 dm^2 and CLmax 1.10; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.10 / 5.688, of the zero lift line

h2_cruise.source: level speed at 75 percent of the throttle stick, derived 17.36, the Kadet's cruise stick; the scale pace of 1.6 Vs, 15.5 m/s, is flown at 70 percent. Derived 21.35 since then, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 12 x 8E curve (prop curves, npm run prop:curves -- wings), was 17.36 on the straight line; the Kadet's proportion about it, 0.860 to 1.165, rounded in.. Re-derived 2026-10-11 again with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool, scripts/lib/propcurve.js electricN): the derivation had flown the stick as the prop's speed share, which the plant has not held since its motor law changed; derived 22.12, was 21.35; the same 0.860 to 1.165, rounded in Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 25.25, was 22.12; the same 0.860 to 1.165 of it (was 19.03 to 25.76).

h3_glide.source: power off at 1.25 Vs, 12.08 m/s: L/D derived 12.43, a sink of 0.97 m/s, on the component build up's CD0 0.0343

Derived 28.64 since then, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 12 x 8E curve (prop curves, npm run prop:curves -- wings), was 23.46 on the straight line; the Kadet's proportion about it, 0.910 to 1.123, rounded in. Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 31.98, was 28.64; the same 0.910 to 1.123 of it (was 26.07 to 32.16).

h5_takeoff.source: Re-derived 2026-10-12 with the ground effect (plant_wing.c GROUND EFFECT, hercules:derive rotationGround, the wing's quarter chord 0.43 m over the grass, sigma 0.35): the ground's lift and its nose down moment, which holds the nose 0.4 deg lower, lift it off at 15.34 m/s after 12.78 m, 0.55 s from VR; the same proportions around it. Was 12.96 to 17.68 m/s and 8.51 to 17.03 m around the free air's 15.32 m/s and 12.77 m. Re-derived 2026-10-11 with the rotation (hercules:derive rotation, FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 6, the pilot of tests/lib/wingpilot.js herculesTakeoffSticks): at VR, 1.1 Vs, the elevator raises the nose toward the lift-off attitude about the main wheels on Iyy, Cm de, the CG's offset from them, the thrust curve and the CG's own inertia as it accelerates, and it lifted off at 15.32 m/s after 12.77 m, 0.55 s from VR in free air (the nose at 1.5 deg, short of the 5.66 deg attitude). The bands keep the old ones' proportions around it (speed plus or minus 15.4 percent, distance plus or minus 33.4 percent). The time from VR is held within 20 percent: the derivation and the plant agree within 11 percent (0.55 against 0.61 s; the speed within 3, the distance within 8), and 9 percent more for what the derivation leaves out (the struts' compliance, the nose wheel's own dynamics), so a plant that rotates wrong still fails. Was: 10.63 to 14.50 m/s and 5.59 to 11.19 m, the lift off at 1.1 to 1.5 Vs, which assumed the rotation instant: on APC's curve the Hercules accelerates through 1.1 to 1.5 Vs in about 0.45 s, faster than a rotation. Before: full throttle on grass from standing, the wings held on the ailerons and the heading on the rudder, the elevator eased up from 1.1 Vs: it lifts off between 1.1 and 1.5 Vs, and between the rolls to those speeds at the rest attitude, 7.06 and 15.80 m (hercules:derive). The rolls are 5.59 and 11.19 m since then, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 12 x 8E curve (prop curves, npm run prop:curves -- wings), was 7.06 and 15.80 on the straight line; the liftoff speeds, 1.1 and 1.5 Vs, are the wing's and do not move. Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): the rolls are 4.65 and 9.20 m, were 5.59 and 11.19; the same 1.52 times them (was 8.51 to 17.04). The liftoff speeds do not move.

h6_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, level, the CG 0.2604 m up and 10.75 percent of the weight on the nose wheel (hercules:derive), within half a degree, 5 mm and a fifth of the share, the Kadet's

h9_doors.source: O in level cruise at 75 percent: the ramp and door open in their 4 s, and the open hold and ramp's drag, 0.0259 on the wing (hercules:derive, ESTIMATED from Hoerner's base drag and plate), slow the level speed to a derived 15.86 m/s, 1.50 under H2's; the band H2's in proportion, the drop within a third. An aircraft without doors refuses them. Derived 19.49 m/s open, 1.85 under H2's 21.35, since then, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 12 x 8E curve (prop curves, npm run prop:curves -- wings), was 15.86 and 1.50 on the straight line; the band H2's proportion about it, rounded in, and the drop within a third, 1.24 to 2.47.. Re-derived 2026-10-11 again with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool, scripts/lib/propcurve.js electricN): the derivation had flown the stick as the prop's speed share, which the plant has not held since its motor law changed; derived 20.20 open, 1.92 under H2's 22.12, was 19.49 and 1.85; the band H2's proportion about it, rounded in, the drop within a third, 1.28 to 2.55 Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 22.97 open, 2.28 under H2's 25.25, was 20.20 and 1.92; the same proportions about them (was 17.38 to 23.53, the drop 1.28 to 2.55).
